profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | React, TypeScript, C#/.NET & Node.js | Application Architecture & Developer Mentorship
profile.summary:
I’m a full-stack software engineer building customer-facing applications with React, TypeScript, C#/.NET, and Node.js. My work combines hands-on feature development and troubleshooting with architectural leadership, developer mentorship, and improvements to how teams deliver software.
At Aderant, I develop billing features across frontend and backend applications. I’ve led architectural decisions for modernizing legacy applications with React, TypeScript, and Material UI, and partnered with my development manager to plan implementation across approximately eight application modules.
I also focus on making development more effective. I migrated frontend tooling from Parcel to Vite, reducing development-server startup from approximately two minutes to under one second. I introduced Vitest and established Playwright testing from scratch, helping expand frontend line coverage from approximately 5–6% to 95%.
Alongside product development, I’ve built internal applications supporting ticket investigation, tenant onboarding, and pull request reviews. These include a desktop application integrating GitHub, Azure DevOps, AI coding agents, and local AI models.
Previously, at GlobeRanger, I developed backend and frontend functionality for real-time asset tracking, geofencing, and hierarchical asset management.
I enjoy owning technical problems from design through implementation, helping other engineers succeed, and building software that makes users’ work easier.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build customer-facing billing applications with React, TypeScript, .NET, and Node.js, spanning feature development, troubleshooting, architecture, and mentorship.
• Delivered invoice roll-ups and editable summary sections, with Node.js backend changes supporting LEDES billing-file submissions.
• Led React, TypeScript, and Material UI modernization of legacy applications, establishing architectural foundations and mentoring developers.
• Partnered with the development manager to plan a rewrite across approximately eight modules, define epics and stories, review approaches, coordinate UI decisions with design, and adjust assignments as priorities changed.
• Migrated Parcel to Vite, reducing dev-server startup from approximately two minutes to under one second and enabling hot module updates in milliseconds.
• Introduced Vitest and established Playwright testing from scratch, increasing frontend line coverage from approximately 5–6% to 95% over roughly six months.
• Currently migrating a .NET email-delivery service from SendGrid SMTP to its API, including retries, delivery tracking, and error handling.
• Rewrote an internal application for development, support, and professional services, improving access to diagnostic data and enhancing tenant setup and onboarding workflows.
• Built a desktop application integrating GitHub, Azure DevOps, AI coding agents, and local models for ticket triage and PR review, with AI summaries, review-readiness checks, and Slack integration.
• Placed in the top 10 of 50 hackathon teams with an AI-agent prototype for rejected-invoice appeals; led data-flow, storage, and processing architecture and collaborated on implementation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed backend services and frontend functionality for asset-tracking applications using ASP.NET Core, React, Redux, Angular, and Azure technologies.
• Developed backend queries and SignalR integrations for an Azure Percept armory-tracking demo, displaying live user identification and weapon checkout status in a React/Redux interface; implemented frontend authorization and checkout-limit checks with on-screen alerts.
• Implemented ASP.NET Core backend functionality and Angular frontend features for geofencing, enabling customers to define map boundaries and verify asset locations within designated areas.
• Co-designed hierarchical asset data structures and implemented backend logic for nested assets, including items assigned to parent containers.

positions.description: Trained with Informatica PowerCenter to design and build Data warehouses.
